# duct-tape2 Repo Launch

Turn one existing GitHub repository into a buyer-ready product website and focused landing page for a fixed $99 USD.

Canonical service: https://duct-tape2.github.io/repo-launch/

Audience: English-speaking open-source maintainers and indie software makers worldwide

Paid inquiry: https://github.com/duct-tape2/duct-tape2/issues/new?template=paid-inquiry.yml

Email: sks7178@gmail.com

## Deliverables

- One focused product website and landing page for an existing public GitHub repository
- Clear offer copy, scope, and buyer call to action
- README offer cleanup
- One public sample or proof section using buyer-provided public material
- Tested inquiry path
- Delivery notes for future edits

Fixed price: $99 USD

Delivery target: four calendar days after scope and payment are confirmed

## Fit

Good fit: an existing public GitHub repository with a working project that needs clearer positioning, proof, and a buyer inquiry path.

Not included: product development, private repository access, analytics access, sales guarantees, paid advertising, security work, credential handling, or payment-account setup.

## Buyer Path

Before paying, open the paid inquiry form or email the public repository URL. Payment acceptance is confirmed individually because the public checkout is temporarily unavailable.

Do not send private credentials, private analytics, or confidential source code.
